summary: Full backend regression on Gakushu Nihongo v2 chapter model. Rewrote test_gakushu_api.py (old file targeted removed /api/lessons). 13/13 pytest cases pass covering public chapters (49 published, 2-50, no answers leaked), auth end-to-end with HttpOnly cookies + forgot-password + change-password, admin login role, admin gating (learner 403), admin CRUD (summary, detail with answer_index, update, publish toggle, reset), LLM quiz padding on chapter 27 (4->15) via GPT-5.4-mini, quiz submission idempotency via operation_id, and progress tracking after passing quiz. Login lockout after 5 failures returns 429 as expected.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py public_chapter builds 'counts' every response, which is fine but each admin list of 49 chapters loads full content docs from Mongo before stripping — consider a projection excluding 'content' to avoid transferring MBs of nested lists on every /api/admin/chapters call.

quiz submission: when duplicate operation_id inserts race, the fallback catches ANY Exception (not just DuplicateKeyError). A transient Mongo write error would silently return a possibly-empty existing doc. Narrow the except to pymongo.errors.DuplicateKeyError.

seed_chapters only runs when collection is empty; there is no versioning, so schema/content changes to ALL_CHAPTERS after first boot require manual /admin/reset per chapter. Consider a content_version field to auto-reseed on bump.

admin_reset_chapter uses upsert=True but relies on a pre-existing doc; if number is missing it will create a doc missing 'number', 'published', 'created_at' fields (matched by filter number but not set explicitly). Add number/published/created_at to $set or $setOnInsert.
CORS fallback allows '*' with allow_credentials=True which browsers reject; ensure FRONTEND_URL is always set in production.
seed_data_creation: Tests create ephemeral TEST_ learner accounts via /api/auth/register. Chapter 27 was padded to 15 then reset back to 4. Chapter 26 title_translation was mutated then restored via reset endpoint. Chapter 2 publish toggled twice (net-zero).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file at /app/backend/tests/test_gakushu_api.py is the current regression suite (13 tests, all pass). pytest.ini enforces -n 2 --dist loadscope; run serial with `-n 0`. REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL must be exported (not auto-loaded from frontend/.env). test_auth_hardening.py also exists but was not exercised this iteration. LLM padding takes ~5-10s and costs Emergent LLM credits — do not repeat unnecessarily.
